items.title: Tommy Ridgley Interview, 1986-03-22
items.q: let you eat some, Ted, you think you, eat some gumbo... do you know, Ted, you ought to go up there sometimes.

ctx.x: And anybody come home can eat. Uh-huh. She always cooking, and she, you know, she can cook, and everybody knew my mama was a good cook, so she cooked good. I'm a little soul cooking. Right. And you see, my wife learned how to cook for my mama. Uh-huh. And, uh, my wife, she cooks. Yeah, I'm, I gotta invite you to my house and let you eat some, Ted, you think you, eat some gumbo, see some gumbo?
She got a single man. I go, I never pass a book. I mean, you know that.
